div.div: صِنَارٌ , as some say, or ↓ صِنَّارٌ , (M,) or both, but the former is the more common, (K,) The kind of tree called دُلْب [i. e. the plane-tree]: (AHn, M, K:) n. un. with ة: (AHn, M:) a Pers. word, introduced into the Arabic language; (Lth, AHn, M;) or arabicized, from [the Pers.] چَنَار. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
